'''Freighter trampers''', also called "'''space hobos'''," were individuals who made their living through hard labor and commuted from job to job on the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] lanes.

==Description==
===Becoming a freighter tramper===
Freighter trampers, also referred to as "space hobos,"<ref name="SWCTP">''[[Star Wars Chronicles: The Prequels]]''</ref> were migrant<ref name="Part56">{{FactFile2014|56|FRE 1-2|AA-9 starfreighter}}</ref> individuals forced to make their living through dangerous hard labor, dangerous maintenance, and repair work. The trampers did everything that needing doing on space [[Transport/Legends|transports]], commuting from job to job on the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] lanes.<ref name="TVD">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> Individuals became freighter trampers through a variety of sobering reasons, such as abandonment, criminal records, debt, personal tragedy, and unemployment. For most, their move to the itinerant lifestyle of a tramper came from necessity rather than the desire to roam [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] deeply inhaling the heady scents of toxic [[Gas/Legends|gas]] emissions or drinking in fine rays of deadly [[Radiation/Legends|radiation]].<ref name="FF36" />

There was often no choice for those who become a freighter tramper, and it was not unknown for trampers to have been down on their luck individuals who had, in effort to escape a [[Planet/Legends|planet]], fall into the company of dishonest [[Captain/Legends|captains]] and crews. Those trampers were stripped of their possessions, their identity, and held hostage by the ship that gave them hope, sometimes with their families. The beings held hostage could suddenly find themselves a virtual [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] with little prospect of rescue or respite.<ref name="FF36" /> In order to earn the cost of their passage to new worlds in search for work, many trampers indentured themselves to corporations. However, many found that when they arrived, their long hoped for employment had disappeared. Those trampers then had to indenture themselves for a second passage to another world. The disappearing employment started a cycle, little different than slavery, in which millions were affected by.<ref name="TVD" />

===Life as a freighter tramper===
Trampers spent most of their lifetime doing their work and were used to utilitarian conditions.<ref name="Insider61">{{InsiderCite|61|Inside Attack of the Clones|Inside ''Attack of the Clones''}}</ref> Many different [[Species/Legends|species]] from across the galaxy that became freighter trampers formed an unlikely alliance<ref name="FF36" /> and a diverse community,<ref name="TVD" /> as they were bound by their common fate. Trampers often grouped together and looked out for each other, though in the end, the laws of survival applied.<ref name="FF36" /> Harsh steerage overseers<ref name="TVD" /> appointed by the freighter operators,<ref name="FF45">{{FactFile|45|FRE 1-2|Coruscant Freighter}}</ref> had the authority to strand miscreants on any [[Star system/Legends|star system]]<ref name="TVD" /> or world<ref name="FF45" /> they passed by, keeping the freighter trampers in line.<ref name="TVD" /> These overseers were armed with [[Stun baton/Legends|stun batons]].<ref name="FF45" />

Freighter trampers bartered with each other for the goods in their possession, often recombining components of disparate origins into workable equipment, known as "tramper gear."<ref name="TVD" /> Experienced trampers frequently manufactured their own tools and often provided designs for manufacturers to follow.<ref name="FF95">{{FactFile|95|HAN 1-4|Hand Tools}}</ref> Tramper gear created included a backpack transponder for mining scouts with housing made with a bedpan, a filter for polluted air in steerage, and a welder made from a [[diatomic bomb igniter]]. Trampers dressed in a bewildering array of [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] that indicated various specialized professions, cultures, or callings. Seasoned trampers could quickly spot fresh synthetic [[Vegetable/Legends|vegetables]] on a tray of [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]], loaded with preservatives, that may have been [[Local year|years]] old.<ref name="TVD" /> Many trampers were [[Death/Legends|killed]] in industrial accidents, having their bodies disposed of unceremoniously by the crew of the ship they worked on.<ref name="FF36" />

Many forms of the media portrayed the life of a freighter tramper as the romantic ideal of a carefree galactic wonderer, even though the truth was harsh and alarming. The life of a tramper was far from the romantic image of a whistling "space-hobo" surviving on wits and astonishing luck.<ref name="FF36" />
